description: Returns pages of one Vogue Paris issue as images, up to 4 at a time, so they can be read, described or translated from the French. Page 1 is the cover, counted the way the site's reader counts. Each page also gets a link to a 2400-pixel scan. Pages are returned for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain); a later issue returns its details and reader link only. Examples: {"issue": "1925-06-15", "pages": [1, 2, 3]}; {"issue": "1922-03", "pages": [10, 11]}.

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")
